title: ECL AARM binding exchange record v1
description: AB1-009: one action's exchange between an AARM control plane and an ECL deployment, as an adapter retains it for audit: the AARM decision, the decision inputs with their classes, the DCMP-2 messages, the release if there was one, and an AARM receipt with the EBMP-2 event that binds it. The decision names are those of the pinned AARM text.

role.description: AB1-001: whether the AARM control plane implements the ECL Decision Layer for this action class or supplies judgment inputs to a separate one.

deadline.description: The deadline of a DEFER or of a STEP_UP approval.

modified_parameters.description: The parameters of the modified action of a MODIFY.

inputs.description: The inputs of the ECL decision: the entries of the decision basis that the response records in ecl.ext.decision-basis.v1, each with the AARM requirement whose output it is where it is one (AB1-006, AB1-013).

aarm_requirement.description: The AARM requirement whose output this input is; R4 is the AARM decision itself.

modification_request.description: AB1-004: the new request for the modified action of a MODIFY.

receipt.description: The AARM receipt as retained. Its members other than receipt_id follow the pinned AARM receipt schema and are kept as the AARM control plane wrote them.

terminal.description: The execution_terminal event that binds the receipt with ecl.ext.aarm-receipt.v1.

release.description: Present only when the enforcement point released the action: the decision request it went ahead under, the parameters digest it released and when.
